hypotheses.label: Beitin (Pleiades 260940008)
hypotheses.reasoning: Pleiades gives the names Bethela and Bethega for Beitin (certain). Recorded here as probable rather than certain because excavation reports and alternative proposals were not read in this session.

description: Northern sanctuary of Jeroboam I (1 Kgs 12:29–33); its altar and high place were destroyed by Josiah (2 Kgs 23:15–18).
